baseline_scoring: reused_prior_completed_scores; not freshly recomputed this phase
seed_interpretation: assignment tie-breaking; potentially identical assignments; not independent model repetitions
history_definition: complete donor input history; donor current state not appended
donor_constraints: train only; different student and split from query
donor current and every history entry strictly before query current
exclude original matched donor and original H/H* payloads
no labels, performance scores, candidate scores or future states used in assignment
context: audit every complete four-condition prompt and every fixed canonical candidate plus one EOS; max context16384; reserve original2048 generation budget despite no generation; no truncation or sample filtering
sequence_protocol: canonical code tokens + exactly one tokenizer EOS; sum logp; no length normalization
selection: argmax; ties use lexicographically smallest candidate_id
data_residency: complete training inputs and new donor histories stay on server; transfer only numeric scores, code-free selections, aggregate reports and acceptance logs

night_resource_authorization.budget_scope: one aggregate ledger across all variants and retries; no reset

limitations: Length/task matching does not equate ability, solution stage or semantic correctness
Source H/H* held fixed except one declared history factor; training donors may be reused
No new generation, A/q implementation, judge execution or correctness evidence
No held-out test inference or efficacy/innovation claim
